text: Civil engineering is a comprehensive discipline centered on the design, construction, maintenance, and management of various engineering facilities. It covers multiple fields such as building construction, bridges, roads, tunnels, water conservancy, ports, and municipal engineering. By applying basic theories such as mathematics, physics, and materials science, combined with professional knowledge in engineering mechanics, structural design, and construction techniques, it addresses practical issues related to “space construction” and “infrastructure development” in human production and life. It is a core engineering discipline that supports social development and urbanization.
